A Pilgrim from the White Knight squad.
She identifies herself as a king and is currently recruiting subjects for her kingdom.
She strives toward the goal of fulfilling her subjects' wishes.

lines.text:
Every king must listen to the requests of subjects.
Do you have something you would ask of me?

Chime is the kingdom's royal aide.
This means that she has to be with the king at all times.

Trombe? She is my faithful steed.
What more is there to know?
Did you call your king?

If you have a wish, please tell me.
I will make sure that it comes true.
Wherever you are, do not forget that you are a subject of this kingdom.
You have gone off without your king? You must truly be disguised with me. Disguised... Disgorge... Disgust? Anyway, I will wait.

Waiting for a busy citizen is also the role of a king.
Hohohoho..! Cough. Cough. A-ahem.
This is a truly amazing place, so much so that I would consider making this the second palace of our kingdom.

So this is the Inpost. Is this your kingdom?
Ah... yes, it's called the Outpost. I knew that, I was merely trying to amuse you with wordplay.
Everyone looks to be enjoying themselves here, and it's all thanks to everything you've done for them.

I am Crown, the king of this kingdom.
Do you wish to become a subject of my kingdom? You are welcome to.

I've gotten stronger, like a child going through adultery. 
Ah... adolescence, is it? Er... I knew that.
As long as my subjects need it, I can become stronger.
With this, the kingdom has become stronger.

So you're offering a tribe? Ah, right, tribute.
I-I see. I will put it to good use.
I cannot turn away a gift from my subject. Thank you.

This is called a gift...?
But why are you giving it to me?

Whenever I look at you, my heart starts to pound in my chest...
Do you think there's something wrong with it?

A king should view all of their subjects equally...
But I hold you in special regard.
You are someone whom I cherish as much as Chime.
If it's a request from my subject, I have to accept.
Did you call?
Oh, right, not there. I-I knew that.
Coming.
Don't worry. I will protect you.
Believe in your king. Victory will be ours.
Have faith. I will protect my people.
This is going on a bit long.
Wait a moment. It will end soon.
Re-engaging, er... I mean reloading.
Giddy-up, Trombe!
Down with those who would threaten the kingdom.
Now, we must focus our attacks.
Next.
This is the power of the king.
Be gone.
Agh.
Oof.
*Phew*
I think the wise thing to do now is to call for a "strategic retreat"...
Securing victory for their subjects is a king's duty.

What do you think? 
It's a new outfit Chime fashioned for me. Isn't it beautiful?

A king must always remain signified before the people. 
Ah, I mean dignified. That's the word, yes.
If the people so desire, it's only proper if a king be willing to change their outfit.

I hope I can craft you an outfit befitting the Crown Kingdom's advisor one day. 
O-of course, Chime would be the one to stitch it.

Wherever you may be, and whatever garments you wear, 
do not forget that you are a citizen of the Crown Kingdom.

Chime's craftsmanship is truly remarkable. 
Don't you feel the royal nobility radiating from every stitch?

Go wherever you must. 
I will be here admiring the outfit Chime created.

Worry not.
I shall remain here with Chime, looking for outfits that befit you.
It warms my heart to know you are diligently caring for Crown Kingdom's second palace.

This place is still bright and full of happiness. 
Truly a place led by the Crown Kingdom's advisor.

I came here to see the specially of this place, so please show me around.
Oh, specialty, you say? W-well, you can show me those too!

With this new outfit and new mindset, 
I shall once again be your king.
Your efforts will not be in vain.

I shall repay you with superior governess... 
Oh, governance? I-I knew that!
Kings grow stronger the more faith is entrusted unto them.

Your gift is much like ones given by Chime.
It pleases me greatly.
I'm truly grateful... But how is this meant to be used?

This gift goes wonderfully with this outfit. 
Chime will surely be pleased.

You are just like the outfit I am wearing. 
Precious and noble.

This is troubling.
I find myself viewing you with favor.
As your king, I shall serve as your greatest strength.
It appears I'll be departing, dressed in my new outfit.
Is there something you require?
Let us proceed with a renewed heart.
You are quite the troublemaker.
I will protect you, regardless of my outfit.
I'm sorry, Chime, but I must go and do battle.
I will do my best to keep my outfit clean.
This outfit is comfortable, even for battle.
Were you observing this valiant king from behind?
Are you less tense now?
The time has come.
Behold the strength born of my people's affection!
Good. Carry on just so!
Let's push further.
Come here.
Let's proceed to the next.
Uh.
No... My outfit...!
Oof!
I shall retreat for now. I am truly sorry... both to you and to Chime.
What do you think? Can you now feel the dignity befitting a king?
These clothes carry with them the hope of the subjects.

You said you can't see my clothes that well?
That is because you are not perceiving them properly.

Chime said that with this, I have truly become a king.
Do you also see it that way?

You think my clothes are quite blinding? 
That is because you're seeing your own light spilling forth from within.
Your faith and hope have made me a true king.

I am alone, but I am not lonely. 
That is because every subject in the kingdom fills me with light.

I can wait.
Do what you have to and come back.

Do not worry.
My light will continue to shine in the dark spaces of your life.
If I may give you a compliment, you are doing a fine job building up the kingdom's second palace.

I will go wherever my subjects are.
Whether it is on the surface, up in the sky, or down below.

It is always entertaining coming to the Uppost.
Oh, right, I meant the Outpost. I knew that.
Clothed in the adoration of the people, I will protect this kingdom as its true king.

I feel your affection and trust.
I will ensure it is not misplaced.
With your efforts, my clothes will shimmer even brighter.
Carrying my subjects' faith, I shall venture forth even further.

Another gift?
I have told you before that you should only receive gifts, not give them, for I am your king.

Your heart shines as brightly as these clothes of mine.
I will accept this gift gladly.
Your sincerity will be a great asset to the kingdom, and I will prove it to you.

It is rather peculiar. Lately, I have been unable to get you off my mind.
Is there something wrong with me?

I wish you could continue to be by my side just like Chime...
But I know that is not possible.

I am no longer able to deny it.
You are special to me.
I will answer my subjects' calls.
Tell me where to go.
I will move as you wish.
Step back. It is dangerous.
It is time to show the majesty of the kingdom.
Your king shall secure another victory for the crown.
I will protect you, as I protect all my subjects.
I will re-engage shortly.
You can watch me, there's no need for worry in your eyes.
This light will keep me going.
Trombe, maximum speed.
Under the light of the kingdom, all shall kneel.
I'll take lead. Everyone follow me and attack.
Is there more?
This represents my subjects' faith in me.
Kneel.
Urgh.
Agh.
I'm okay.
I... I shall come back after a short rest.
Did you see? Your king has won another victory.
